about: String decay per note (tools/fitting/fit_decay.py fit): amplitude decay rates σ (1/s) of the prompt sound and the aftersound, for each measured partial (from 1), and above them the law σ = b1 + b3·f² (f in Hz). With the unison spread they set the coupled two-stage decay (engine/src/NoteModel.cpp). fitRmsDb: each measured partial's window-level error.
